BiblicalUsage: Nahum is the prophet of the burden of Nineveh, and his whole book is one verse of introduction and three short chapters of judgment. In Nahum 1:1 the burden of Nineveh is called the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite, and the vision that follows is the fall of the city Jonah once warned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Nahum is the other half of Jonah, because the city that repented once fell later when it went back to its cruelty. God's patience is long, but it is not endless, and Nineveh learned both.
